card.name: And/or after an adverb or adjective
card.fires_on: The linking word "and" or "or" right after a manner word such as careful, safe or solemnly, where a second matching adjective or adverb comes next.

modes.label: After other manner words
modes.description: "and" or "or" after words like safe or solemnly, before a paired word such as effective or formally.
modes.example: Proper patient selection is critical to the safe<< and>> effective use of SYMLIN.

card.writes: It favors adverb-like endings (fully, ally, iously), suggesting a paired manner word follows.
card.plain: It fires on "and" or "or" joining two descriptive words, as in "careful and constant" or "safe and effective".
